intro: The accommodation pack, for hotels, guest houses and short-lets: the front desk, the room rack, housekeeping, each guest's bill and the night audit. Switch it on for the places that let rooms in Settings › Industry packs; the rooms and stays themselves live in Bookings.
start: Switch the accommodation pack on in Settings › Industry packs, for the places that let rooms.
Add your room types and rooms in Bookings › Rooms, tables and staff, and the stay guests book in Offers and rates.
Add your rate plans, seasons and special dates on Rates.
Open the Front desk each morning: who is arriving, who is in the house and who is leaving.

articles.title: Check a guest in
articles.summary: The front desk lists today's arrivals with whether their room is ready. Check them in and their folio opens.

steps.rest: and find the guest under Arriving.
A guest goes only into an inspected room, or a clean one if your settings allow it. Where it says Check before check-in, sort that out first.
The guest moves to In the house.

tips: For someone who walks in without a booking, press Walk-in. The new booking starts on today.
Press New booking to take a booking for another day.

articles.title: Charge, take payment and check a guest out
articles.summary: A folio holds everything a guest owes: room nights, charges from the tills and anything you add. Take payment and settle it when they leave.

steps.rest: from Folios or the Front desk.

tips: A till at any outlet can charge to the room by its number, and the charge lands on the open folio of the guest staying there.
Service charge and VAT are worked out on each charge and shown on the folio, never hidden in the rate.

articles.title: Bill a company for a guest's stay
articles.summary: Say a company pays the room nights or everything, and the guest pays the rest. The company's share becomes one invoice when you settle.

articles.title: Correct a charge on a folio
articles.summary: A posted line never changes. A correction adds a line that turns it round, so the bill shows what happened.

steps.rest: and find the line under Lines.

tips: A correction can never take off more than the line it corrects.
A folio with no lines can be voided instead, with a reason.

articles.title: Move a stay to another room
articles.summary: The room rack shows each room by night with a bar for each stay. Move a stay to a free room in a few clicks.

steps.rest: and find the week. Use Today or the arrows to move about.

tips: A move is refused when another stay holds that room on those nights. Nothing changes.
Stays with no room yet are listed under the rack, ready to be given one.

articles.title: Get rooms cleaned and ready
articles.summary: Housekeeping shows which rooms are dirty, clean, inspected or out of order, with the cleans asked for and who does them.

articles.title: Set room rates, seasons and special dates
articles.summary: A rate plan moves a room type's base rate, then seasons, weekends and special dates move it again. Try a price to see each step.

steps.rest: on Rates. Choose the room type and the rule: a share of the base rate, an amount on it, or a set price.

tips: Seasons repeat every year and may run over the new year, but they may not overlap.
A special date with a price replaces everything before it for that night.

articles.title: Close the day with the night audit
articles.summary: The night audit posts a room night to each guest in the house, marks no-shows and counts the folios still owing.

steps.rest: Each night, after the place's audit time, yesterday is closed for you.

steps.lead: To close a past day by hand,
steps.rest: go to Close a day by hand and choose the day to close.
The list shows the nights posted, the no-shows and the folios still owing.

tips: A day is closed once. A room night is never posted twice to the same folio.
